dedupe_keys.name: dataprocessing data model of the german electricity system part of the open ego project egodp

description: DataProcessing – Data Model of the German Electricity System (part of the open_eGo project) (eGoDP) is a model listed in Open Energy Platform model and framework factsheets, a public register of energy-system model and framework factsheets under the section "Models", published or maintained by ZNES Flensburg (ZNES), Reiner Lemoine Institut (RLI), DLR Institute of Networked Energy Systems (DLR), Otto-von-Guericke-Universität Magdeburg (OvGU). The DataProcessing is a collection of scripts to process input data to be used for the other eGo-Tools. The resulting input data is published and available. Coverage: Germany. Spatial resolution: national states, regions, NUTS 3, municipalities, districts. Software: Python, PostgreSQL, pandas, workalender, oemof.db, demandlib, ego.io, geoalchemy2. The listed link gives the source code or documentation; nothing was downloaded or run. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Affero General Public License Version 3. Caveats: this record was written from the Open Energy Platform factsheet only, so the code, documentation and any publication it links were not opened, their current availability was not checked, and the factsheet may lag the project. It can support energy-system planning and scenario studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-oep-factsheet-catalogue.
